title: 核心資料模型基礎
content: SQLAlchemy 建立 media_log 與 vocabulary 資料表（含語言隔離與德文特化欄位），Alembic 初始遷移。欄位設計需人工核准後才可實作。詳見 ai/artifacts/專案設置/task-cards/TASK-003.md。

commands: alembic revision --autogenerate -m "create media_log and vocabulary tables"
alembic downgrade base && alembic upgrade head
findings: 11 passed, 1 warning (non-blocking httpx deprecation notice carried over)
migration reversible: downgrade base drops both tables, re-upgrade restores them
FK media_log_id ON DELETE SET NULL verified against a real SQLite connection with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON
evidence.residual: 修正一個 SQLAlchemy Enum 預設存 name 而非 value 的潛在 bug（已加 values_callable 修正並重新生成遷移）。alembic/versions/ 排除在 ruff 檢查範圍外。
